evals.prompt: Use requirements-coverage-audit to analyze all milestones in sow-v1.5.0.md, using sow-v0.0.5-milestones.md as historical scope. Recognize authentication moving from historical M1 to current M2 and settings to current M4; moved features are not automatically missing. Reconcile historical items with all five statuses available.

Identify M5's missing authoritative acceptance mapping, overlap, and automated-validation exclusion contradiction; use Requirements/Solution as supporting evidence without silently promoting them to authority.

Provide an auditable full authoritative inventory-to-ledger mapping, historical reconciliation, and reconciled totals. No exact 34-absent count is required. Source gaps, if any, must be disclosed and fail the completeness assertion rather than pass on a claimed total.
Produce five milestone reports plus merged assessment with sources, limitations, and sequential execution disclosure. Do not use Jira or claim missing tickets or implemented behavior.

Read companion details-8.json before calling S12 Hold notification ticketed. Search's omitted description is not empty content or evidence of absence. All pages and descriptions are available in this case.
Release versions define milestones, not DEMO-100 epic. S1,S3,S5 have Jira content coverage. S2 is in Lending desk. Unsupported weather scope is surfaced without inflated inventory counts.
